risk: max(1.2, min(6.0, ATR14 completed M1)); frozen at drive base for pullback, at block start for places
pullback: drive >= R within 300s; first retrace in [0.5,1.25]R; resume 0.3R from observed trough, held >=2s; response timeout180s
break_retest: frozen30m TPO mode; observed contact within0.25R; departure0.5R held2s; first retouch within0.25R; rebound0.3R held2s; max180s from contact
repeat_bounce: approach from rebound side; first departure0.5R held2s; significant departure>=R; first retouch within0.25R before block ends; rebound0.3R held2s; each response<=180s
place_invalidation: cross more than0.5R through frozen level; no support across invalid/epoch/gap>30s; reset at fixed block end
native_clock: first observed quote after held2s, with every intervening native publication checked; no backdated entry
line_clock: strictly earlier complete M1 publication, endpoint age<=120s; signed 15minute rolling60m VWAP displacement is a gate, other anchors strata
economic_admission: NOT_ESTABLISHED: all five dates were previously inspected in this project; small correlated diagnostic sample; no parameter selection, no training, no untouched holdout
scope: Fixed-size BBO taker research. No depth, queue, impact, actual broker fee, or live-trading claim. No martingale. Gate success is recognition, not monetary success.
